data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Update on customer service re: broken nightstand](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/666983372637356705e6a75e)

I am updating this review to reflect that I received assistance from Lulu and Georgia who provided a full refund. Because of the poor quality of the piece, I won’t order from them again, but I’m very appreciative of the customer service.

I just received an expensive new nightstand from Lulu and Georgia and noted right away that I couldn’t easily open the second drawer and the third drawer didn’t open but an inch or two. The delivery person yanked the second drawer open, and now it won’t close. I called right away, and can only communicate via a VM, and then sent a message through their messaging line. No response. Left another VM and sent a second and third message. This should be a priority for the company. This isn’t the case of a ding or a scratch but a completely unworkable piece of furniture. The fact that I can’t speak to a live person is extremely frustrating. I have no idea when/if this will be resolved.

June 9, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Updated Jun 14, 2024

Hi Melissa, Thank you for your feedback and we are so incredibly sorry to hear about the condition of the nightstand that was delivered. We can see you corresponded with our Customer Experience team. They’ve escalated the issue with our supplier and they processed a full refund.
